# Missing Technology Icons

This file tracks technology names that don't have corresponding icon files in `/public/skills/`.

When a project references a technology that lacks an icon, it will be logged here automatically during development.

## Icon Naming Convention

Icons should be named using one of these patterns:
- `{technology-name}-icon.svg` (preferred)
- `{technology-name}.svg`

Example: `react-icon.svg`, `nodejs.svg`
